title: Bubonico
extract:
The Bubonico is an  Infested Shotgun Arm-Cannon that launches a barrage of  Toxin blasts from its primary fire, while its Alternate Fire shoots three explosive  Viral shots in a burst. The arm-cannon does not have ammo reserves, and instead regenerates ammo.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage and innate  Toxin on its primary fire and  Viral on its Alternate Fire.
Primary fire shoots 7 pellet barrages in a fully automatic fashion.
Alternate fires a three round burst that explode in a 7 meter radius upon impact with a surface or enemy.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
This weapon does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time.
Has a 1.5 second delay after the weapon stops firing before regenerating ammo. Then, regenerates 9 ammo per second; takes 3 seconds to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay. This delay is affected by Reload Speed.
If the magazine is completely emptied, the reload delay is shortened to 0.1 seconds.
Does not benefit from mods that increase maximum ammo, due to lack of an ammo pool.
Advantages over other Primary  Shotgun weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Primary Fire:
Innate punch through allows hitting multiple targets in line.
High accuracy.
Alternate Fire:
Pinpoint accuracy.

Acquisition
The Bubonico's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Notes
Bubonico uses shotgun mods.
Primary fire has 1.9 meters of Punch Through.
Alternate fire explosion has a 7 meter area of effect.
Each shot in the burst consumes 3 rounds (9 rounds per burst).
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion has an innate +9s status duration bonus.
Bonus is applied before other percentage sources of status duration.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% over 7m.
Reload has a 1.5 second delay before ammo begins to regenerate. Ammo regenerates at 9 ammo per second; taking 3 seconds to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay.
If the magazine is completely emptied, the reload delay is shortened to 0.1 seconds.
It is officially classified as a Launcher and cannot be used in missions with Shotgun-Only restrictions.

Known Bugs
 Galvanized Savvy is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits.
 Handspring and  Constitution have no effect on the knockdown caused by Bubonico's alternate fire.

Tips
There are several ways to make use of the Alternate Fire's high critical damage by adding flat critical chance bonuses:
 Adarza Kavat  Cat's Eye periodically grants an additive 60% boost to critical chance.
 Smeeta Kavat's  Charm periodically grants a fixed 200% critical chance as one of its possible effects.
With another player using the  Mutalist Quanta's Alternate Fire, shooting through the orb adds a flat +25% critical chance, in addition to +25% critical damage and extra  Electricity.
 Harrow's  Covenant can add up to +50% additive crit chance, or +200% on headshots, after absorbing enough damage.
A fully ranked  Arcane Avenger has a 21% chance upon receiving damage to grant +45% flat critical chance.
 Mesa's  Ballistic Bullseye allows for a single bullet and subsequent explosion to gain an additive critical chance bonus, scaling with Ability Strength.
 Citrine's  Crystallize spawns a large crystal growth on enemies, shooting the growth inflicts a fixed 300% critical chance.

Trivia
Bubonico is a play on Bubonic plague, one of three variants of Plague best known as the cause of the Black Death.
Bubonic itself is derived from Bubo, painful swelling of the lymph nodes around the neck, groin, and armpits.
Bubonico is the second arm cannon added in WARFRAME.
Bubonico's Alternate Fire has the highest status chance of all weapons.
The Bubonico is possibly an infested Grineer weapon, as between the tendrils at the front is an inorganic, trefoil-shaped barrel, similar to the Ogma's demolition cannon.
